scoring_methodology.mq: Quadrants from mid=5.5 on market-specific X/Y axes derived from feature envelopes + SCR evidence. Thin/unverified evidence demotes toward Niche / lowers Y.
scoring_methodology.gmq: Independent Completeness of Vision × Ability to Execute axes — not interchangeable with MQ Leaders.
scoring_methodology.wave: Offering / Strategy / Presence scores; Wave roster is top-N composite among MQ cores (see per-market methodology.wave_selection).
scoring_methodology.blue_ocean: KCF radar for contrast among a shortlisted peer set — not an alternate Leader definition.
scoring_methodology.unknowns: Unsupported matrix cells and thin SCR claims must read as unknown — never inferred capability.
scoring_methodology.coi: Report authored in the Silver Bullet repo via silver-deep-research-multi-ai; SB appears in charts — see report COI disclosure.
